corrections: Existing agents rule 1 (register with FSU) is incomplete. The February 2026 procedures add that registration is annual, that it must be done 'within seven (7) business days of first contact', and that agents must file an Athlete Representation Disclosure Form after signing an athlete.

Existing agents rule 2 says the athlete 'must tell' Compliance before first contact, quoting the Compliance web page ('provided the student-athlete notifies'). The February 2026 procedures say 'It is advised that' the athlete notify Compliance. The two official sources differ. The newer document should control, or the conflict should be shown.

Existing agents rule 2 says agents who write to athletes must send a copy to Compliance. The February 2026 procedures instead say agents 'must notify FSU Athletics Compliance Office prior to initial contact occurring'.

Existing collectives rule can move from read_method extraction to raw_text. Both quotes are exact. Change 'would be dissolved' to FSU's wording 'will be formally dissolved'. The release text says 'announced Monday' although it is dated 8/27/2025.

not_found items 'current facility-use rule for NIL shoots' and 'current rule on wearing the uniform in NIL content' are now answered by the Use of Marks PDF, with the caveat that it is dated 2/2/2024.
The existing logos rule names Trademark Licensing and Global Partnerships. The Use of Marks PDF confirms this and adds that the uniform counts as a mark.

Existing own-merchandise rule (group licensing royalties) is supported by page 3 of the Use of Marks PDF. That page names the Compass App, OneTeam, The Brandr Group and The NIL Store, which may be out of date.

notes: Historical only, from the 2021 policy PDF: athletes may mention USF but 'may not use USF's marks' except through contracted licensees or sponsors, under USF policy 0-215; a disclaimer is required when USF is mentioned; no deals that tie USF's name or marks to competitors of exclusive sponsors (it names Coca-Cola and adidas) or to alcohol, tobacco, nicotine devices, marijuana, controlled substances, performance enhancing substances, sports betting, casino gambling or adult entertainment; disclose through INFLCR within 5 days; no contract past participation at USF; USF Athletics facilities need prior approval, insurance and a licensing agreement; international athletes should ask the USF Office of International Services.

The 2021 policy says USF-affiliated entities and employees 'may not compensate or cause compensation to be directed to athletes'. That reflects the repealed 2021 Florida law and is out of date after the House settlement.
